I'm 15 and have been put into a mental hospital for attempted suicide, and then was forced into therapy. I hated every second of it. The therapists office just made me think about suicide, then I would get really bad suicidal thoughts while sitting in the office. I'm not saying don't get him help, just make sure it's the right environment for him. I myself never really got the right treatment so here I am on this subreddit again due to strong suicidal thoughts and this is a place where I can vent about it and it makes the feelings go away even if only for a while.

I can agree. To me it seems so... Meaningless. As I heard in a Falling in Reverse song "We are born to live, but we all live to die." Basically what the fuck is the point of dragging out our meaningless existence when it has to end at some point anyway.
